  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · MATRICES AND DETERMINANTS
    - heading "Solving Linear Equations by Matrices" [level=1]
    - text: Solve the system using matrices. Change constants to see unique, no, or infinite solution cases. Algebra steps and graph stay in sync. 16 min ADVANCED CONCEPT matrix systems
    - link "← School lessons":
      - /url: /lessons/school
    - article:
      - text: System (edit constants) 2x + 1y =
      - spinbutton "first equation constant": "5"
      - text: 1x − 1y =
      - spinbutton "second equation constant": "1"
    - article:
      - text: Solution status
      - strong: ✓ Unique solution
      - paragraph: det(A) = -3 ≠ 0
    - article:
      - text: Case explorer
      - paragraph: Try other cases
      - combobox "Case explorer":
        - option "Unique solution (det(A) ≠ 0)" [selected]
        - option "No solution (parallel)"
        - option "Infinite solutions (same line)"
        - option "Random values"
    - heading "Algebra Solver" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Synchronized matrix solution
    - article:
      - heading "1 Matrix form AX = B" [level=3]
      - text: A = [2 1; 1 -1] X=[x;y] B=[5;1]
      - complementary: 🔵 Row 1 → 2x + 1y = 5 🔴 Row 2 → 1x − 1y = 1
    - article:
      - heading "2 Determinant of A" [level=3]
      - text: det(A) = (2)(-1) − (1)(1) = -3 det(A) ≠ 0 → A is invertible. Unique solution exists.
    - article:
      - heading "3 Inverse of A" [level=3]
      - text: A⁻¹ = 1/-3 [-1 -1; -1 2]
    - article:
      - heading "4 Solve X = A⁻¹B" [level=3]
      - text: X = [2; 1]
      - strong: Solution x=2, y=1
    - article:
      - heading "5 Verification (substitution)" [level=3]
      - complementary: 🔵 2(2) + 1(1) = 5 ✓ 🔴 1(2) + -1(1) = 1 ✓
      - text: Both equations are satisfied.
    - article:
      - text: "⚠ Important: order of multiplication"
      - paragraph: Matrix multiplication is not commutative. A⁻¹B is correct. Always multiply in the order X=A⁻¹B.
    - heading "Graph (linked to algebra)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The lines correspond to matrix rows.
    - complementary:
      - button "Fit graph":
        - img
      - button "Reset graph":

      - button "Zoom graph":
